aha_moments.suggestion: Single Contracts/Inma/ root with Dtos/ + Webhooks/ subfolders mirrors INMA-side organization.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Reviewer opens Contracts/Inma/ and sees the entire INMA wire surface in one tree, no archeology needed.

aha_moments.user_pain: Onboarding devs grep namespace by guess to find webhook payload shape.
aha_moments.aha_moment: New dev searches 'Inma.Webhooks' and lands on the exact file in seconds.

aha_moments.user_pain: DTO duplication risk if next dev adds a parallel WebhookMessage in Contracts/Inma/.
aha_moments.suggestion: Hard cut migration removes old path immediately; no alias trap.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Future PR cannot accidentally import the legacy version — it doesn't exist.

aha_moments.user_pain: When INMA changes a JsonPropertyName, support has to grep across two folder trees to confirm parity.
aha_moments.suggestion: Co-locating WapCrm + Webhook DTOs under Contracts/Inma/ enables a single diff against INMA model docs.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Compliance check becomes 'open one folder, compare', not multi-grep.

aha_moments.user_pain: Q's mental model of 'INMA boundary' was scattered across 4 namespaces.
aha_moments.suggestion: Invekto.Shared.Contracts.Inma.* is the only INMA boundary namespace going forward.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Q reads code and instantly knows: if it's not under Contracts.Inma, it isn't an INMA wire contract.
